expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Declares the generic map type. Each TMap<K,V> instantiation validates key hashing/equality and value operations. Declares the mutable map iterator type. Declares the read-only map iterator type. Constructs an empty map; element lifetimes are managed automatically. Copy-constructs a mutable iterator. Reports whether the mutable iterator refers to a valid entry. Copy-constructs a read-only iterator. Reports whether the read-only iterator refers to a valid entry. Iterates mutable or read-only values through the opFor protocol. Iterates keys and values together through the opFor protocol.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result. Verify size, element values, ordering, and empty result behavior that apply to the listed overloads.
inputs: Nominal values for every listed parameter, one default or empty state, and one behavior-specific boundary derived from the registration notes.
